boundary: Manuscript metric-readiness matrix for submission positioning. It adds no formal benchmark, reports only a residual-boundary Pauli-event surrogate plus a method-level lattice sanity aggregation and simplified finite-squeezing toy-channel sanity check for channel language and a non-inferential paired-bootstrap envelope for source-data transparency, does not estimate finite-energy logical-channel fidelity, does not provide inferential confidence intervals, and does not validate hardware.

rows.manuscript_metric: final_ler_mean plus paired descriptive deltas and non-inferential paired-bootstrap envelope
rows.current_status: supported under the current software-HIL protocol
rows.source_data_or_literature: source_data_fig02_main_results.csv; source_data_fig02_paired_deltas.csv; submission_draft_paired_uncertainty_analysis.csv; predeclared software-HIL comparison CSV and JSON
rows.allowed_claim: Hybrid residual calibration has the lowest mean protocol-defined final_ler in the tested drift scenarios
rows.missing_for_stronger_claim: paired inferential confidence intervals; more repeats; holdout drift families; logical-channel reconstruction

rows.manuscript_metric: residual-boundary Pauli-event surrogate plus method-level lattice sanity summary and finite-squeezing toy-channel sanity check
rows.current_status: supported only as surrogate event decomposition, aggregation and toy measurement-channel sanity
rows.source_data_or_literature: submission_draft_logical_channel_surrogate_analysis.csv; submission_draft_lattice_logical_channel_sanity.csv; submission_draft_finite_energy_channel_sanity.csv; jafarzadeh2025; hastrup2023; zheng2024; external channel-level GKP analyses
rows.allowed_claim: The manuscript can link q/p half-lattice crossing events to channel language and report mean/worst-state surrogate fidelity readouts plus a simplified finite-squeezing sanity check while stating that finite-energy logical-channel fidelity and process infidelity are not estimated
rows.missing_for_stronger_claim: channel-specific calibrated finite-energy GKP simulation; logical-channel tomography or process-fidelity estimation; source data for true channel probabilities

rows.manuscript_metric: scenario-wise final_ler ranking plus controlled local-Gaussian checks, holdout drift stress tests and commit-lag sweep
rows.allowed_claim: Controlled stress diagnostics expose where stale commits help or fail under random-walk, burst/reset and faster-than-window settings without establishing trained-branch holdout robustness
rows.missing_for_stronger_claim: formal predeclared expanded benchmark; repeat-expanded uncertainty estimates; trained-branch holdout validation; board-measured stale-parameter latency distributions

rows.manuscript_metric: analytical per-shot operation count plus Q4.20 software parity
rows.current_status: supported as analytical and software-emulation motivation only
rows.allowed_claim: The affine correction has a smaller analytical per-shot arithmetic/state footprint and Q4.20 software emulation introduces no residual-boundary crossing change under the controlled sample set
rows.missing_for_stronger_claim: FPGA synthesis; timing closure; power and resource measurements; source-vs-board agreement; board-level latency distribution

rows.current_status: not yet supported by device measurements
rows.source_data_or_literature: planned hardware-measurement table; real-time FPGA decoder literature
rows.allowed_claim: The manuscript may define the measurement surface required for future hardware validation
rows.missing_for_stronger_claim: board logs; bitstream or RTL hash; DMA or MMIO evidence; latency and resource reports; commit reliability; source-vs-board vectors
